Subject: Re: Insurance requirements for MSA/Order Form (COI + endorsement)

Marissa — reviewed Acme's spec. High level: we can meet most items but recommend narrow, defensible language and some commercially reasonable exceptions. Notes below and a proposed redline snippet.

1) Additional insured: we can provide Additional Insured status on the CGL via an endorsement (e.g., CG 20 10 or equivalent). We should not extend Additional Insured to Professional Liability / E&O — carriers generally won't endorse PL/E&O. We should propose: "Additional Insured: ACME Corporation, to the extent related to services performed by Redwood and only for Commercial General Liability coverage."

2) Primary & Non-Contributory; Waiver of Subrogation: acceptable but should be qualified by insurer capability and applicable law. Recommend: "Coverage shall be primary and non-contributory and waiver of subrogation will be provided where permitted by law and the insurer's policy terms."

3) Cyber limits: 5M is above our current placement; we can commit to $3,000,000 without an underwriting change. If Acme requires $5,000,000, we need either a premium adjustment or an excess cyber policy (pricing TBD). Ask: will they accept $3M + $2M excess?

4) Insurer rating: reasonable to require A- or equivalent. We can provide carrier name and AM Best rating on the COI.

5) SIR / deductible: if we provide higher cyber limits via SIR, disclose SIR amount. Suggest disclosing a $250k SIR for cyber if required.

Proposed redline snippet to send to Acme: 

"Insurance: Supplier shall maintain, at Supplier's expense, insurance in the types and amounts set forth below. Supplier shall provide a Certificate of Insurance and, where requested, an Additional Insured endorsement for Commercial General Liability. Coverage limits: Commercial General Liability $1,000,000 per occurrence/$2,000,000 aggregate; Umbrella/Excess $2,000,000; Professional Liability $1,000,000; Cyber/Network Security $3,000,000 (Supplier may provide higher limits via excess policies). Additional Insured: ACME Corporation shall be named as Additional Insured on the Commercial General Liability policy to the extent arising out of Supplier's operations. Coverage shall be primary and non-contributory and waiver of subrogation will be provided where permitted by law and the insurer's policy. Supplier shall use commercially reasonable efforts to obtain endorsements and will provide 30 days' notice of cancellation where available. Insurers shall have a minimum rating of AM Best A- or equivalent."

I attached a short redline doc for your records (MSA_redline_insurance_20260309.docx). If Acme pushes on 5M cyber, we should ask for confirmation on cost and consider offering 3M now with an optional upgrade.

If you want, I can draft one more-brief email to procurement with the compromise language.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
